description: This file defines custom expectation matchers for Playwright testing framework, including proxy-based matcher creation, polling support, and integration with test info and step management.

classes.name: ExpectMetaInfoProxyHandler
classes.description: Proxy handler for managing expectation matcher properties and polling logic.

methods.name: createMatchers
methods.description: Creates a proxy for matchers with attached expectation info and prefix.

methods.name: createExpect
methods.description: Creates a proxy-based Expect object with support for extension, soft expectations, and polling.

methods.name: setMatcherCallContext
methods.description: Sets the current matcher call context for tracking.

methods.name: takeMatcherCallContext
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the current matcher call context.

methods.name: wrapPlaywrightMatcherToPassNiceThis
methods.description: Wraps a matcher to pass Playwright-specific context and timeout.

methods.name: throwUnsupportedExpectMatcherError
methods.description: Throws error for unsupported custom matchers.

methods.name: pollMatcher
methods.description: Performs polling for a matcher until timeout or success.
